prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1037; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of lower back pain and muscle spasm. The mechanism of the impact is consistent with the lumbar strain diagnosed, and the reported symptoms align closely with the force involved. Over the course of 18 visits, treatment followed a conventional progression consisting of manual therapy, targeted stretching, core strengthening, and home exercise instruction. Range of motion and paraspinal tenderness improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced as function returned. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient reports a remote, minor strain in the same region several years ago that resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single entries for each service with no repeated charges. At discharge the patient was ambulating independently with near-normal lumbar mobility and was advised to continue a self-directed exercise program.
